dictionary.name: measure
dictionary.description: the summary statistics a selection member may carry (D68): each entry gives a measure its name, its unit when it has one of its own, and — as its `function` — how its values combine when tiles are rolled up to a coarser level

measures.name: mean
measures.description: the field's weighted mean over the member

measures.name: max
measures.description: the largest value on the member

measures.name: min
measures.description: the smallest value on the member

measures.name: mean_square
measures.description: the mean of the square — rms is its root, taken at read because rms does not add

measures.name: sum
measures.description: the total over the member

measures.name: abs_max
measures.description: the largest magnitude on the member — the peak of a signed field

measures.name: area
measures.description: the member's own area — a geometric measurement, with no field

measures.name: n_elements
measures.description: the member's own element count — a geometric measurement, with no field

measures.name: amplitude
measures.description: mean |z| over the member — the band's amplitude; the level says which band

measures.name: power
measures.description: mean |z|² over the member — rms is its root, taken at read because rms does not add

measures.name: weight
measures.description: Σa — the area the sums below are over (vertices with a value)

measures.name: sum_square
measures.description: Σa·x² — with `sum` and `weight`, the mean square and the variance at any roll-up

measures.name: count
measures.description: how many values (vertices, good samples) the member holds

measures.name: power_sum
measures.description: Σ a·|z|² of the band's analytic signal over the member — power per sample per area is it over weight × samples

measures.name: envelope_sum
measures.description: Σ a·|z| — the band's envelope, summed

measures.name: envelope_max
measures.description: the largest |z| on the member — the band's envelope peak

measures.name: gradient_1
measures.description: Σa·(∇x)_1 in the canonical frame (e1 north, e2 west, n out) — the gradient's moments

measures.name: gradient_2
measures.description: Σa·(∇x)_2 in the canonical frame (e1 north, e2 west, n out) — the gradient's moments

measures.name: gradient_n
measures.description: Σa·(∇x)_n in the canonical frame (e1 north, e2 west, n out) — the gradient's moments

measures.name: gradient_11
measures.description: Σa·(∇x)_11 in the canonical frame (e1 north, e2 west, n out) — the gradient's moments

measures.name: gradient_22
measures.description: Σa·(∇x)_22 in the canonical frame (e1 north, e2 west, n out) — the gradient's moments

measures.name: gradient_12
measures.description: Σa·(∇x)_12 in the canonical frame (e1 north, e2 west, n out) — the gradient's moments

measures.name: gradient_magnitude
measures.description: Σa·(∇x) magnitude in the canonical frame (e1 north, e2 west, n out) — the gradient's moments

measures.name: gradient_weight
measures.description: Σa over the vertices with a gradient

measures.name: tensor_11
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component 11 in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: tensor_22
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component 22 in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: tensor_nn
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component nn in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: tensor_12_re
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component 12_re in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: tensor_12_im
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component 12_im in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: tensor_1n_re
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component 1n_re in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: tensor_1n_im
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component 1n_im in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: tensor_2n_re
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component 2n_re in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: tensor_2n_im
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component 2n_im in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: tensor_total
measures.description: Σ a·J_i·J_j* of the band's analytic current, component total in the canonical frame (Hermitian; re/im)

measures.name: variance
measures.description: the variance on the member — E[x²] − E[x]², exact at any roll-up because both ingredients roll up

measures.name: sd
measures.description: the standard deviation on the member — √(E[x²] − E[x]²), exact at any roll-up because both ingredients roll up

measures.name: rms
measures.description: the root mean square — √mean_square, rooted at read because rms does not add

measures.name: peak_to_peak
measures.description: max − min on the member

measures.name: crest_factor
measures.description: the peak against the rms — abs_max / √mean_square; how spiky the member is

measures.name: envelope_variance
measures.description: how much the band's amplitude fluctuates within the member — power − amplitude², the same identity as variance applied to the envelope
